title: Financial services: bank
industry: Banking (IFRS primary ledger; US GAAP and local GAAP as delta ledgers from Phase 2)
note: Sealed: each file's SHA-256 is recorded, so a pack version cannot change silently. After a reviewed change, run python -m volt_ledger.pack fs-bank 1 and bump the version if the content is in client use.

reference_chart.what: Reference chart of accounts: segments, ranges, hierarchy, a concept on every posting account, decisions

ontology.what: Canonical concepts with IFRS and US GAAP lines and XBRL names, calculation and presentation arcs

ontology_insurance.what: IFRS 17 and segregated fund concepts, for bancassurance groups

information_model.what: Reference finance information model (FSDF-derived): contracts, positions, events, journals, GL balances

map_rules.what: Which GL account each balance type of each product posts to

attributes.what: Finance data requirements catalogue: source attributes per kind of balance, why, and the data quality rule

metrics.what: KPI definitions computed from the ledger

exam.what: The exam and its answer keys, scored on the synthetic bank test bank

mapping_answer_key.what: People-written answer key: concept per synthetic bank account, and its seeded policy gaps

test_bank.what: Synthetic bank trial balance used by the exam
